name: Prima Assicurazioni S.p.A.
note: Milan insurtech (an MGA, distributing policies of Great Lakes Insurance (Munich Re group) and others). Shareholding as reported by Milano Finanza, 17 February 2025: Teodoro D'Ambrosio 48%, Blackstone 27%, Goldman Sachs 15%, top management 8%, Carlyle 2%. A reshuffle of the capital or a stock-market listing has been discussed in the Italian press since 2023, so the stakes may since have changed.
